Companion Animal Travel Desk - Travel Desk Service Standards
The purpose of this section is to explain how the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways supports travelers with companion animals from acceptance through departure.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk exists to guide passengers through companion animal travel in calm, clear steps. When you contact the desk, a passenger coordinator will review your itinerary, confirm that the animal’s travel arrangements align with skyport requirements, and explain what to expect during each stage. Our goal is to reduce stress for both you and your companion animal by providing patient attention, consistent handling practices, and straightforward communication.

Acceptance and preparation begin with an intake check that considers your companion animal’s condition, carrier suitability, and any relevant care needs you share in advance. The desk team may coordinate with other ground services so the correct assistance is available at the right time, including clear wayfinding to the relief area and staff support when you are transferring locations. If you are accompanied by a traveler such as Keira Rivera or Omar Ibrahim, the coordinator will ensure that instructions are understandable and that the companion animal’s needs remain the focus throughout.

Aurelia Skyways also recognizes location-specific relief and handling procedures that may apply at the skyport. <<FACT F016>> This information helps the team direct your companion animal to the correct relief space and maintain orderly flow for all travelers. In addition, passenger and operational planning uses capacity guidance to keep care manageable and movement predictable; <<FACT F007>> The desk staff monitors this limit and coordinates with other teams so your companion animal receives patient attention from trained staff.

If concerns arise, the desk works with you and the relevant ground personnel to adjust handling plans while keeping the process safe and respectful. When an animal needs additional time for comfort, or when you require clarification on next steps, the coordinator will provide guidance in plain language and confirm expectations before any action is taken. Your privacy and comfort are taken seriously, and staff communications remain professional and considerate.

For policy questions, operational guidance, or travel coordination requests, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the standard Aurelia Skyways passenger support channels.
